summary.en-US: Connect Zen Browser tabs to your favorite local apps and launchers.

description.en-US:
Your Zen tabs, connected to your favorite tools.

Built for Zen Browser (https://zen-browser.app/) on macOS. Firefox is not a supported target.

Find open and pinned tabs from compatible local apps, launchers, or scripts, then switch to the existing tab without opening duplicates or typing into the address bar. Works with the companion Raycast integration and other clients; Raycast is optional.

The connection stays on your Mac. No cloud account, remote server, or analytics. Private tabs are excluded. Tab URLs and titles are shared with local apps running as your user, so use clients you trust.

Requires Node.js 22+ and the separately installed local helper. The add-on alone does not provide a search interface or install the helper.

Setup: https://github.com/sandzhaj/Zen-Browser-Bridge#install-macos
Privacy: https://github.com/sandzhaj/Zen-Browser-Bridge/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

Pinned names retain the first title observed during the bridge session; later sidebar renames and workspace names are not exposed.

An independent community project, not affiliated with Zen Browser or Mozilla.

version.approval_notes: Requires the macOS Native Messaging host. Host source and setup are at https://github.com/sandzhaj/Zen-Browser-Bridge . No build step or minification; addon/ is the complete browser source. Data is sent only to local clients.
